scope: Acceptance audit, not blanket milestone completion

milestones.note: 20 locked ELF rows: precision and recall 1.0. Held DOL recall 0.9937888198757764, precision 0.9566517189835575; DOL gate constrains only recall.

Fresh references and strings pass 20/20 each; standalone/pooled prototype and positive switch checks pass. Signature build passes 4/4; library identification finds 871 correct matches with zero false positives across 3 architectures. Itanium RTTI passes 9 rows with one Linux MSVC-corpus skip; MSVC RTTI passes 10 rows with five MSVC-corpus skips. The native constant-propagation test filter executes two passing tests. These scoped gates are not blanket C1 certification. Full switch comparison also passes 20/20, but every locked row has zero switch tables; the separately executed positive fixture supplies the nonempty recovery check.

Fresh broader DWARF acceptance passes with its existing named exceptions and MSVC off-Windows skips; frozen 20-row stock baseline reproduces; fresh regression passes 20/20 with the existing i386 arity deficit.
Fresh enabled/disabled register-parameter scoring passes: i386_many_o2 arity 0 to 1, no other row loses. Aggregate passes; opt-in policy unchanged.
